title: Simplify Web3 Onboarding with Single Sign On
summary: Web3 Single Sign-On solutions are an effective way to create a seamless UX for your users. Get started with DropChain.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
For the last 7 years, I've evangelized the adoption of web3 technology through marketing and product design. In that time, I've tested countless strategies to attract and delight first-time web3 users.

After all of those tests, failures, and successes, one thing consistently stands out as being critically important when it comes to onboarding massive amounts of first-time web3 users: User experience.

Also known as UX, user experience is critical for any technology to achieve in a competitive market with an attention deficit. For web3 products, it's especially important. 

Today, I'm going to show you the easiest way to make it easy for anyone to start using your web3 app, even if they don't have a wallet. 

‍

Grow with SSO

Generating and holding a crypto wallet for the first time is an intimidating complicated process. First-time users with little web3 experience are handed extremely sensitive private keys with little context or education.

This is a huge responsibility for first-time crypto users. Many people don't have the experience, knowledge, or desire to control such sensitive information. Inevitably, many of those users lose their keys and get hacked or scammed. Then, they walk away from web3 too scared to return. There goes the dream of mass adoption.

Web3 Single Sign-on (SSO) offers a different approach. SSO is a way for users to easily sign up and log in to blockchain applications using traditional web2 credentials. Instead of managing keys and connecting a wallet, users can sign up and log in as they do for any web2 website.
